This installed.adb was generated by apk-tools 3.0.8-r0 in
alpine@sha256:ff7f0c727dd796aa36787bfcd9a64bf35a6ce72a73451b3359fde849b6703d63
on linux/arm64.

Command: cd /tmp && apk convdb

The adjacent reference/installed-v2 is the original database before
conversion. The apk-tools adbdump command reports 16 installed packages.
Ravel's test checks selected identities and the complete package and
dependency counts against this original.

reference/installed-deflate6.adb and reference/installed-none.adb were
generated from the same Alpine image with `apk convdb --compression deflate:6`
and `apk convdb --compression none`. The Alpine image's apk-tools build
does not include zstd support, so reference/installed-zstd.adb contains
the tool-generated uncompressed ADB database wrapped as `ADBc` with
algorithm 2, level 3, and a zstd level-3 frame produced by the zstd CLI.
The integration test compares all variants with the original v2 graph.
